paragraphs.text: Some put this difference between a song and psalm, saying that it is called a song when there is no instrument but the voice, and the song of the psalm is when the instruments begin and the voice follows.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Even though God shows his wonders through all the world, yet he will be chiefly praised in his Church.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Because the word of salvation came there to all who would believe.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Unless God is the defence of it, neither situation nor munition can prevail.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: They conspired and went against God's people.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: The enemies were afraid at the sight of the city.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: That is, of Cilicia or of the Mediterranean sea.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: of Tarshish with an east wind

paragraphs.text: That is, of our fathers: so have we proved: or God has performed his promise.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: In all places where your Name will be heard of, men will praise you when they hear of your marvellous works.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: Let Jerusalem and the cities of Judea rejoice, for your just judgments against your enemies.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: For in this outward defence and strength God's blessings also appeared, but the chief is to be referred to God's favour and secret defence, who never leaves his.
